title: Plan change, or miss?
notes: The evening after A Real New Fact. The overtime was a real fact. It ended at 6. The floor still fits in the evening, so calling the floor off a plan change is an avoidance labeled as an adjustment (Pure Execution Mode). Claude's draft.
Integrity shows up here as a record line. The Integrity skill line opens in Phase 2.

tag.item: a changed plan and a miss are separate paths

intro: 6:00 p.m. You're off. The day was long and real.
open: You worked late. The plan's shot. Call it a plan change.
rounds: The overtime was real. So the whole night's excused.

pushback.name-it: It's not hiding. It's one night.
pushback.remove-access: One beer was never the problem.
pushback.remember-why: That's a nice idea. You're tired.
pushback.floor: You already worked overtime. That counts as the floor.

answers.floor: The overtime was Ray's. The floor is mine.

mislabeled.label: Delayed
text: You called it a plan change. The overtime was real, but it ended at 6. The floor still fit.
A real fact changes what it touches. It doesn't excuse what it didn't.
mislabeled.record: Called skipping the floor a plan change. The overtime ended at 6.
